claimChecks.claim: VoiceGremlin's API accepts a phone number and test case for testing a voice agent.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: You pass the API a phone number and a test case like "Verify that the agent does X."

claimChecks.claim: VoiceGremlin has bots converse and uses an LLM judge to return a pass/fail result to a pipeline.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: It calls your voice agent, tests the thing by having the bots talk to each other, and uses LLM-as-judge to provide a pass/fail for your pipeline.

claimChecks.claim: The official product describes its service as end-to-end testing through real phone calls and a REST API.
claimChecks.evidenceQuote: E2E testing for AI phone agents - real phone calls, real audio, any functional test, via REST API.
